page.notes: The left-margin note is in three lines and reads "Materiæ re- / sponsionum / ad querelas / epistolas." The word "querelas" is set in the margin in italic and is partly unclear, so the reading is doubtful. Several Greek words in the running text are not readable at this scan resolution and are marked illegible. The lines after "Responsiones" and "Mentione" appear to be list items. The first printed line "tur.li.3" is a continuation from the previous page. The printed "reprehen" / "sione" break has no visible hyphen, so it is written as one word.
